Lakers Nation > Blog > Lakers News > Austin Reaves Loves That This Lakers Team Has No Egos Lakers News Austin Reaves Loves That This Lakers Team Has No Egos
 Corey Hansford Published: 10/27/2026 4 Min Read Oct 25, 2026; Salt Lake City, Utah, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves (15) holds the ball defended by Utah Jazz guard Keyonte George (3) during the second half at Delta Center. Mandatory Credit: Rob Gray-Imagn Images SHARE The Los Angeles Lakers improved to 3-0 with their win over the Utah Jazz on Sunday. Luka Doncic and his virtuoso 52-point performance will get the majority of the attention, and rightfully so, but Austin Reaves continued his excellent start to the season and the Lakers got big contributions from others as well.
 Of course, it will always be Doncic and Reaves leading the way, but the likes of Collin Sexton, Ziaire Williams, Matisse Thybulle and Sandro Mamukelashvili all had an impact in the comeback victory. And in talking about this squad, Reaves made note of the fact that this Lakers team has no egos and everyone is locked in on doing whatever needs to be done to win.
 “It’s just make the right play, it’s simple,” Reaves said on Spectrum SportsNet . “You know I talk about it all the time and it’s something that my parents and my brother taught me growing up was, you play the game the right way, the game is gonna reward you. 
 “We have a team that understands roles and what is asked of them to do. And if they’re gonna do everything that we ask them to do, you gotta help them in situations. That’s, I think, the beautiful thing about our team is there’s no egos, there’s no anything. You just wanna win basketball games and however that happens is the main thing.”
 The first quarter in Utah was one to forget as the Lakers had no energy and even with Doncic getting off to a strong scoring start, the Lakers trailed by 18. But the second quarter saw a complete shift as Sexton changed the tone with his energy and Reaves scored 15 of his 29 points in that period. And once the momentum got going, it never stopped as Thybulle and Williams kept up the pressure and Doncic knocked down some huge shots to end the half.
 This Lakers team has a ton of interchangeable wings between Thybulle, Williams, Jake LaRavia and Quentin Grimes, not to mention Adou Thiero and Cameron Carr when they get healthy. On any given night, any of them could have the hot hand and make the huge impact which could lead to fluctuating minutes. But if the entire team is all on one accord, focused on winning above all else, it allows for everyone to support each other without egos getting in the way, and that ultimately leads to success.
 JJ Redick believes Lakers’ win over Jazz can be reference point
 The fact that the Lakers were able to fight back from 18 points down in the first quarter when they could have allowed things to get out of hand was a good sign for head coach JJ Redick, who believes this win over the Jazz can be used as a reference point for this team’s resiliency .
